description: This header file declares utility functions for converting OpenCdmError statuses to strings and MediaKeyErrorStatus within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. It includes external headers related to OpenCdm and media common definitions, and defines functions for error handling related to OpenCdmError.

methods.name: openCdmErrorToString
methods.description: Converts an OpenCDMError status to its string representation.

methods.name: convertOpenCdmError
methods.description: Converts an OpenCDMError status to a MediaKeyErrorStatus.
